L0: import sys
L1: 
L2: sys.path.append("../")
L3: sys.path.append("../parser")
L4: 
L5: from run_parser import get_identifiers
L6: import logging
L7: import numpy as np
L8: import pandas as pd
L9: from utils import get_identifier_posistions_from_code, Individual, Population
L10: import logging
L11: 
L12: logging.basicConfig(
L13:     format="%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - %(name)s -   %(message)s",
L14:     datefmt="%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S",
L15:     level=logging.INFO,
L16: )
L17: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
L18: 
L19: class MOAA:
L20:     def __init__(
L21:         self, args, model, tokenizer, t5_model, t5_tokenizer, t5_emb_model, pop_size
L22:     ):
L23:         self.args = args
L24:         self.model = model
L25:         self.tokenizer = tokenizer
L26:         self.t5_model = t5_model
L27:         self.t5_tokenizer = t5_tokenizer
L28:         self.t5_emb_model = t5_emb_model
L29:         self.pop_size = pop_size
L30:         self.parent_pop = Population(self.pop_size)
L31:         self.offspring_pop = Population(self.pop_size)
L32:         self.mixed_pop = Population(self.pop_size * 2)
L33:     def attack(self, idx, orig_code, label):
L34:         self.parent_pop.indi = []
L35:         self.offspring_pop.indi = []
L36:         # check whether the original code can be predicted correctly by victim model
L37:         prob = self.model.predict(orig_code)
L38:         orig_label = np.argmax(prob)
L39:         orig_prob = np.max(prob)
L40:         query_times = 0
L41:         flag_success = False  # whether we have found the first adversarial example in our algorithm
L42:         is_success = 0
L43:         identifiers, code_tokens = get_identifiers(orig_code, "python")
L44:         identifiers = [i[0] for i in identifiers]
L45:         if orig_label != label:  # the original code is misclassified
L46:             is_success = -4
L47:         elif len(identifiers) == 0:  # no identifier in the code
L48:             is_success = -3
L49:         else:  # begin to attack
L50:             names_positions_dict = get_identifier_posistions_from_code(
L51:                 code_tokens, identifiers
L52:             )
L53:             pos_dict = []
L54:             self.max_iteration = 5 * len(identifiers)
L55:             for i in identifiers:
L56:                 pos_dict.append(names_positions_dict[i])
L57:             # Initialze the population
L58:             for i in range(self.pop_size):
L59:                 self.parent_pop.indi.append(
L60:                     Individual(code_tokens, identifiers, pos_dict, orig_label)
L61:                 )
L62:                 self.offspring_pop.indi.append(
L63:                     Individual(code_tokens, identifiers, pos_dict, orig_label)
L64:                 )
L65:                 self.parent_pop.indi[i].mutation(self.t5_model, self.t5_tokenizer)
L66:                 self.mixed_pop.indi.append(
L67:                     Individual(code_tokens, identifiers, pos_dict, orig_label)
L68:                 )
L69:                 self.mixed_pop.indi.append(
L70:                     Individual(code_tokens, identifiers, pos_dict, orig_label)
L71:                 )
L72:                 self.parent_pop.indi[i].function_eval(
L73:                     self.model, self.tokenizer, self.t5_emb_model, self.t5_tokenizer
L74:                 )
L75:                 if flag_success == False:
L76:                     query_times += 1
L77:                     if (
L78:                         self.parent_pop.indi[i].label_ != orig_label
L79:                     ):  # the first adversarial example is found
L80:                         flag_success = True
L81:             # Begin the evolution process
L82:             for i in range(self.max_iteration):
L83:                 # crossover
L84:                 self.offspring_pop.crossover(self.parent_pop)
L85:                 # mutation
L86:                 self.offspring_pop.mutation(self.t5_model, self.t5_tokenizer)
L87:                 # evaluate the objectives of the offspring population
L88:                 for j in range(self.pop_size):
L89:                     self.offspring_pop.indi[j].function_eval(
L90:                         self.model,
L91:                         self.tokenizer,
L92:                         self.t5_emb_model,
L93:                         self.t5_tokenizer,
L94:                     )
L95:                     if flag_success == False:
L96:                         query_times += 1
L97:                         if self.offspring_pop.indi[j].label != orig_label:
L98:                             flag_success = True
L99:                 # environmental selection
L100:                 self.parent_pop.environmental_selection(
L101:                     self.offspring_pop, self.mixed_pop
L102:                 )
L103:         # attack finished, save the results
L104:         if is_success == -4 or is_success == -3:
L105:             res = [
L106:                 [
L107:                     idx,
L108:                     orig_code,
L109:                     len(orig_code),
L110:                     None,
L111:                     label,
L112:                     orig_label,
L113:                     None,
L114:                     is_success,
L115:                     ",".join(identifiers),
L116:                     None,
L117:                     orig_prob,
L118:                     None,
L119:                     None,
L120:                     None,
L121:                     query_times,
L122:                 ]
L123:             ]
L124:         else:
L125:             if flag_success == True:
L126:                 is_success = 1
L127:             else:
L128:                 is_success = -1
L129:             res = []
L130:             for indi in self.parent_pop.indi:  # save each individual in the population
L131:                 if (
L132:                     indi.label_ != orig_label
L133:                 ):  # this individual is an adversarial example
L134:                     success = 1
L135:                 else:
L136:                     success = -1
L137:                 res.append(
L138:                     [
L139:                         idx,
L140:                         orig_code,
L141:                         len(orig_code),
L142:                         " ".join(indi.tokens_),
L143:                         indi.label_,
L144:                         orig_label,
L145:                         success,
L146:                         ",".join(identifiers),
L147:                         ",".join(indi.identifiers_),
L148:                         orig_prob,
L149:                         indi.obj_[0],
L150:                         indi.obj_[1],
L151:                         indi.obj_[2],
L152:                         query_times,
L153:                     ]
L154:                 )
L155:         df = pd.DataFrame(data=res)
L156:         df.to_csv(self.args.csv_store_path, mode="a+", header=False)
L157:         logger.info("******End Attack, result={}******".format(is_success))
L158:         return is_success
